newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JUNINHO FUTURE STILL IN DOUBT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUNINHO FUTURE STILL IN DOUBT.

text.p: Middlesbrough insisted on Thursday they have accepted an offer for Brazilian midfielder Juninho from Tottenham and no deal had been agreed with Atletico Madrid.
"The situation at the moment is that we've accepted a bid from Tottenham and we have given Juninho the opportunity to speak to them," said Middlesbrough spokesman Adrian Bevington.
The Spanish club claimed they had signed Juninho on Wednesday. "We have confirmed 100 percent the deal," said Miguel Angel Gil Marin, son of club owner Jesus Gil, on Spanish television.
Recent Spanish reports suggested Atletico would pay $20.1 million for Juninho compared with Tottenham's bid of $18.4 million.
Speculation has mounted about Juninho's future since Middlesbrough were relegated from the premier league last season.
He has repeatedly said he would prefer a move to Spain but with two years remaining on his contract with Middlesbrough, they appear to hold the key to his future.

Despite Spanish press report that Juninho's father, who is also his agent, has said he will move to Atletico, Middlesbrough would not be drawn on whether they were in negotiations with the Spanish club.
"The situation is no comment from Middlesbrough," said Bevington.
